2: use verus_builtin::*;

11:

13: verus! {
14: 
15: pub struct Request {
16:     pub rid: int,
17:     pub req: int,
18: }
19: 
20: pub struct Response {
21:     pub rid: int,
22:     pub resp: int,
23: }
24: 
25: #[is_variant]
26: pub enum Client {
27:     Idle,
28:     Waiting { rid: int },
29: }
30: 
31: #[is_variant]
32: pub enum Combiner {
33:     Collecting { elems: Seq<Option<int>> },
34:     Responding { elems: Seq<Option<int>>, idx: nat },
35: }
36: 
37: } 
38: tokenized_state_machine! {
39:     FlatCombiner {
40:         fields {
41:             #[sharding(constant)]
42:             pub num_clients: nat,
43: 
44:             #[sharding(imap)]
45:             pub clients: IMap<nat, Client>,
46: 
47:             #[sharding(imap)]
48:             pub slots: IMap<nat, bool>,
49: 
50:             #[sharding(variable)]
51:             pub combiner: Combiner,
52: 
53:             #[sharding(storage_imap)]
54:             pub requests: IMap<nat, Request>,
55: 
56:             #[sharding(storage_imap)]
57:             pub responses: IMap<nat, Response>,
58:         }
59: 
60:         pub open spec fn valid_idx(self, i: nat) -> bool {
61:             0 <= i && i < self.num_clients
62:         }
63: 
64:         #[invariant]
65:         pub fn clients_complete(self) -> bool {
66:             forall |i: nat| (0 <= i && i < self.num_clients) ==
67:                 self.clients.dom().contains(i)
68:         }
69: 
70:         #[invariant]
71:         pub fn slots_complete(self) -> bool {
72:             forall |i: nat| (0 <= i && i < self.num_clients) ==
73:                 self.slots.dom().contains(i)
74:         }
75: 
76:         #[invariant]
77:         pub fn clients_size(self) -> bool {
78:             match self.combiner {
79:                 Combiner::Collecting{elems} => elems.len() <= self.num_clients,
80:                 Combiner::Responding{elems, idx} => elems.len() == self.num_clients &&
81:                     0 <= idx && idx <= self.num_clients,
82:             }
83:         }
84: 
85: 
86:         pub open spec fn client_waiting(self, i: nat) -> bool {
87:             self.valid_idx(i)
88:             && self.clients.index(i).is_Waiting()
89:         }
90: 
91:         pub open spec fn combiner_has(self, i: nat) -> bool {
92:             self.valid_idx(i)
93:             && match self.combiner {
94:                 Combiner::Collecting{elems} => i < elems.len() && elems.index(i as int).is_Some(),
95:                 Combiner::Responding{elems, idx} => i >= idx && elems.index(i as int).is_Some(),
96:             }
97:         }
98: 
99:         pub open spec fn combiner_rid(self, i: nat) -> int {
100:             match self.combiner {
101:                 Combiner::Collecting{elems} => elems.index(i as int).get_Some_0(),
102:                 Combiner::Responding{elems, idx} => elems.index(i as int).get_Some_0(),
103:             }
104:         }
105: 
106:         pub open spec fn request_stored(self, i: nat) -> bool {
107:             self.requests.dom().contains(i)
108:         }
109: 
110:         pub open spec fn response_stored(self, i: nat) -> bool {
111:             self.responses.dom().contains(i)
112:         }
113: 
114:         #[invariant]
115:         pub fn not_waiting_inv(self) -> bool {
116:             forall |i: nat| #[trigger] self.valid_idx(i) && self.clients.index(i).is_Idle() ==>
117:                 !self.slots.index(i)
118:         }
119: 
120:         #[invariant]
121:         pub fn waiting_inv(self) -> bool {
122:             forall |i: nat| #[trigger] self.client_waiting(i) ==>
123:                 self.request_stored(i) || self.response_stored(i) || self.combiner_has(i)
124:         }
125: 
126:         #[invariant]
127:         pub fn request_stored_inv(self) -> bool {
128:             forall |i: nat| #[trigger] self.request_stored(i) ==>
129:                 self.client_waiting(i)
130:                 && self.requests.index(i).rid == self.clients.index(i).get_Waiting_rid()
131:                 && self.slots.index(i)
132:         }
133: 
134:         #[invariant]
135:         pub fn response_stored_inv(self) -> bool {
136:             forall |i: nat| #[trigger] self.response_stored(i) ==>
137:                 self.client_waiting(i)
138:                 && self.responses.index(i).rid == self.clients.index(i).get_Waiting_rid()
139:                 && !self.slots.index(i)
140:         }
141: 
142: 
143:         #[invariant]
144:         pub fn combiner_has_inv(self) -> bool {
145:             forall |i: nat| #[trigger] self.combiner_has(i) ==>
146:                 self.client_waiting(i)
147:                 && self.slots.index(i)
148:                 && self.combiner_rid(i) == self.clients.index(i).get_Waiting_rid()
149:                 && !self.request_stored(i)
150:         }
151: 
152:         init!{
153:             initialize(num_clients: nat) {
154:                 init num_clients = num_clients;
155:                 init clients = IMap::new(
156:                     |i: nat| 0 <= i && i < num_clients,
157:                     |i: nat| Client::Idle);
158:                 init slots = IMap::new(
159:                     |i: nat| 0 <= i && i < num_clients,
160:                     |i: nat| false);
161:                 init combiner = Combiner::Collecting { elems: Seq::empty() };
162:                 init requests = IMap::empty();
163:                 init responses = IMap::empty();
164:             }
165:         }
166: 
167:         #[inductive(initialize)]
168:         fn init_inductive(post: Self, num_clients: nat) { }
169: 
170: 
171:         transition!{
172:             client_send(j: nat, request: Request, cur_slot: bool) {
173:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
174: 
175:                 remove clients -= [j => Client::Idle];
176:                 add    clients += [j => Client::Waiting{rid: request.rid}];
177: 
178:                 remove slots -= [j => cur_slot];
179:                 add    slots += [j => true];
180: 
181:                 deposit requests += [j => request] by {
182:                     assert(!pre.request_stored(j));
183:                 };
184:             }
185:         }
186: 
187:         #[inductive(client_send)]
188:         fn client_send_inductive(pre: Self,
189:             post: Self, j: nat, request: Request, cur_slot: bool)
190:         {
191:             admit()
192:         }
193: 
194:         transition!{
195:             client_recv(j: nat) {
196:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
197: 
198:                 remove clients -= [j => let Client::Waiting{rid}];
199:                 add    clients += [j => Client::Idle];
200: 
201:                 have slots >= [j => false];
202: 
203:                 withdraw responses -= [j => let response] by {
204:                     assert(pre.client_waiting(j));
205:                 };
206: 
207:                 assert(response.rid == rid) by {
208:                     assert(pre.client_waiting(j));
209:                 };
210:             }
211:         }
212: 
213:         #[inductive(client_recv)]
214:         fn client_recv_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, j: nat) {
215:             admit()
216:         }
217: 
218: 
219:         transition!{
220:             combiner_recv() {
221:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Collecting());
222:                 let j = pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().len();
223:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
224: 
225:                 have slots >= [j => true];
226: 
227:                 withdraw requests -= [j => let request] by {
228:                     assert(pre.valid_idx(j));
229:                     assert(pre.client_waiting(j));
230:                     assert(pre.request_stored(j));
231:                 };
232: 
233:                 update combiner = Combiner::Collecting{
234:                     elems: pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().push(Option::Some(request.rid)),
235:                 };
236:             }
237:         }
238: 
239:         #[inductive(combiner_recv)]
240:         fn combiner_recv_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
241:             admit()
242:         }
243: 
244:         transition!{
245:             combiner_skip() {
246:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Collecting());
247:                 let j = pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().len();
248:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
249: 
250: 
251:                 update combiner = Combiner::Collecting{
252:                     elems: pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().push(Option::None),
253:                 };
254:             }
255:         }
256: 
257:         #[inductive(combiner_skip)]
258:         fn combiner_skip_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
259:             admit()
260:         }
261: 
262:         transition!{
263:             combiner_go_to_responding() {
264:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Collecting());
265:                 require(pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().len() == pre.num_clients);
266:                 update combiner = Combiner::Responding{
267:                     elems: pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems(),
268:                     idx: 0,
269:                 };
270:             }
271:         }
272: 
273:         transition!{
274:             combiner_send(response: Response, cur_slot: bool) {
275:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Responding());
276:                 let j = pre.combiner.get_Responding_idx();
277:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
278:                 let response_opt = pre.combiner.get_Responding_elems().index(j as int);
279: 
280:                 require(response_opt == Option::Some(response.rid));
281: 
282:                 remove slots -= [j => cur_slot];
283:                 add    slots += [j => false];
284: 
285:                 update combiner = Combiner::Responding{
286:                     elems: pre.combiner.get_Responding_elems(),
287:                     idx: j + 1,
288:                 };
289: 
290:                 deposit responses += [j => response] by {
291:                     assert(pre.valid_idx(j));
292:                     assert(pre.combiner_has(j));
293:                     assert(!pre.response_stored(j));
294:                 };
295:             }
296:         }
297: 
298:         #[inductive(combiner_send)]
299:         fn combiner_send_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, response: Response, cur_slot: bool) {
300:             admit()
301:         }
302: 
303:         transition!{
304:             combiner_send_skip() {
305:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Responding());
306:                 let j = pre.combiner.get_Responding_idx();
307:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
308:                 let response_opt = pre.combiner.get_Responding_elems().index(j as int);
309: 
310:                 require(equal(response_opt, Option::None));
311: 
312:                 update combiner = Combiner::Responding{
313:                     elems: pre.combiner.get_Responding_elems(),
314:                     idx: j + 1,
315:                 };
316:             }
317:         }
318: 
319:         #[inductive(combiner_send_skip)]
320:         fn combiner_send_skip_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
321:         }
322: 
323:         #[inductive(combiner_go_to_responding)]
324:         fn combiner_go_to_responding_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
325:             admit()
326:         }
327: 
328:         transition!{
329:             combiner_go_to_collecting() {
330:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Responding());
331:                 require(pre.combiner.get_Responding_idx() == pre.num_clients);
332:                 update combiner = Combiner::Collecting{ elems: Seq::empty() };
333:             }
334:         }
335: 
336:         #[inductive(combiner_go_to_collecting)]
337:         fn combiner_go_to_collecting_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
338:             admit()
339:         }
340: 
341:     }
342: }
